GLOBAL-DQ-074.reason: venue_object is a global mechanism the sport can populate at any time, and BMX simply holds no active link at stage, event or Comp.Rank level yet, so the check covers every event and reports every event. That is a proportion rather than a per-event defect: SPORTS/Curling.md records that venue is newly populated in this database and the backfill is still ahead, and BMX is at nought per cent of it. The signal is Monitor rather than Not applicable because the absence is a row count, which CLAUDE.md forbids classifying away. SPORTS/BMX.md owns the finding.

GLOBAL-DQ-033.reason: Phase is not universal for this sport: a large share of active BMX Comp.Rank participant rows carry no phase row at all, so the check reports a large share of the population. The proportion is the finding. SPORTS/BMX.md owns the coverage statement.

GLOBAL-DQ-064.reason: Structural: BMX is contested individually. Its competition model fields no teams, so an athlete belongs to none and the 1429 Team field has nothing to hold - populating it would require teams the sport does not race. The registry carries team participants, but none of them enters an event. The 102 findings from 102 eligible rows are the evidence for that model, not the basis for the classification, which is what keeps this Not applicable rather than a row count. SPORTS/BMX.md owns the finding.

GLOBAL-DQ-098.reason: Structural: the check asserts the 1429 Team field where a statistic ranks teams, and BMX ranks no teams at any level - it is contested individually and its Comp.Rank statistics rank athletes. The eligible population is therefore permanently empty rather than empty today, which is the difference POWERBI.md draws between a misdirected scope and a sentinel: this is neither, it is a structure the sport does not have. BMX-DQ-078 keeps its row and its ID.

GLOBAL-DQ-074.reason: The check measures how far the venue backfill has reached. 16764 of 17920 active events resolve to no venue, while 739 carry their own venue_object link and 417 inherit one from their stage, so the mechanism is in use and filling. The proportion is the finding and no single event is a defect. SPORTS/Curling.md records the backfill and keeps the check instantiated for exactly that reason. An earlier revision recorded this as Not applicable on the strength of the unfilled majority, which both contradicted that section and misstated the sport - events do resolve to venues here.
